signal_text: Gumroad's Terms of Service (effective January 1, 2025) states that Gumroad holds sole discretion to determine and change eligible product categories for resale at any time, that Gumroad is the merchant of record for all resales, and that sellers are prohibited from issuing invoices or demanding payment directly from buyers.
subject_exact: Gumroad sole discretion over product eligibility and merchant of record status with seller invoice restriction
local_qualifiers: fraudulent or illegal under any applicable law
extraction_notes: Terms establish Gumroad as MOR. Seller explicitly prohibited from invoicing buyers. Eligibility criteria subject to unilateral change by Gumroad at any time.
